description: Convert a column of amounts to a base currency using a supplied rate table. When amounts in mixed currencies must be brought to one base. Do not choose this when live or date-specific rates are required. Example requests: Convert these amounts to USD. | Normalise this column to a single currency. | Apply this rate table to my rows.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

base_currency.description: The customer's base.txt, as text. Supported: A short code. The base currency code. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

rates.description: The customer's rates.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. One 'CURRENCY=rate_to_base' per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

rows.description: The customer's rows.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. The rows to convert. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_fx_rate_normaliser
title: FX rate normaliser
